I have farmed these lands since I was a young girl, and I know my beans grow well with the manure from our goats and chickens. Chemical fertilizer is too costly for legumes, and the rains have always been enough for this small plot. I will use the seeds I saved from last season’s harvest, but I must buy a small sachet of medicine for the insects that always come for the leaves. My children and I will do most of the work, though I may pay a few young men to help when the weeding and harvesting are heavy.
